regime.label: Hawkish-Fed war-shock: equities still pricing complacency
regime.oneLiner: A rallying stock market and a bond market at its most stressed since 2008 are telling two different stories, and a hard 4-5 day deadline on Iran's Hormuz ultimatum means next week likely forces a resolution one way or the other.

topNews.headline: Wall Street closes hawkish week with a rally as 10-year yield hits post-2008 high
topNews.actionable: Equities shrugging off 5%+ yields is a near-term risk-on tell, but the yield/vol divergence still favors keeping the cash pile large rather than chasing the rally.

topNews.headline: Iran hands US a 4-5 day ultimatum on Hormuz reopening terms
topNews.actionable: The ultimatum clock (expiring roughly Mon-Tue 28-29 Sep) is the key weekend-into-week catalyst for oil and therefore for silver/gold-miner beta -- watch for escalation risk overriding the truce-hope rally that's been capping crude.

topNews.headline: BofA Flow Show: global equity funds swing to outflow as US leads the reversal
topNews.actionable: A one-week swing from the best equity-inflow week in three months to an outright outflow, arriving right as the 10-year hit a post-2008 high, is an early tell that positioning is starting to react to the hawkish Fed -- don't read Friday's index rally as confirmation the flow backdrop has turned durably risk-on.

topNews.headline: Houthis strike Saudi Aramco's Yanbu hub and a Riyadh target; six missiles intercepted
topNews.actionable: Continued Houthi strikes on Saudi infrastructure alongside the Hormuz ultimatum keep the oil-shock/inflation-hedge case for gold-silver miners intact even as Friday's tape pulled back -- don't read the daily pullback as thesis-breaking.

topNews.headline: Gold and silver pull back on stronger dollar and higher real yields
topNews.actionable: This is the key near-term risk for the levered silver/gold-miner book: rising real yields are the dominant headwind right now, not falling geopolitical risk -- a further leg up in the 10Y toward/through 5.2-5.3% would likely pressure GDX/SILJ/SLVP further even if the war premium in oil holds.

signals: MP Materials remains the model's highest-conviction rare-earth call (pUp3m 0.60, confidence 0.55) on its DoD equity stake and $110/kg NdPr price floor -- this week's Trump-Xi summit held the trade truce at status quo with no new concessions on magnet flows, reinforcing rather than resolving the thesis -- consider watching for continuation.

GLD/SLV keep a double-digit 12-month expected return (ev12m 0.09/0.10) despite extending Friday's dollar-driven pullback -- consider watching whether the miners decouple positively if the Iran ultimatum deadline (~Mon-Tue) produces fresh escalation.
